data.name: Furaat
data.gender_notes: Furaat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Furaat is an Arabic name which means 'stream'. It is a unisex name, used for both boys and girls. The name Furaat carries the meaning “Stream” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Furaat usually hope their child will grow to embody stream and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The one who is like a flowing stream, constantly nourishing and giving life to everything around.
data.etymology: Furaat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Stream.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Furaat total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: فرات
in_arabic.meaning: فرات اسم يعني الفرع أو النهر أو الماء الكثير الجميل
in_arabic.long_meaning: فرات هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه الفرع أو النهر أو الماء الكثير الجميل. ورد ذكر اسم فُرَات في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفجر الآية 21 {إِنَّهُم كَانُوا قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ مُسْرِفِينَ * كَانُوا يَقُولُونَ أَإِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَإِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ * أَوْ آبَاؤُنَا الْأَوَّلُونَ * قُلْ نَعَمْ وَأَنتُمْ ذَاهِبُونَ * فَذَلِكِ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَوْمٌ مَبْعُوثُونَ * إِلَى رَبِّكُمْ فَمَن أَعْمَالُهُ مِنكُم مَّا شَاءَ فَلْيَعْمَلْ لِمَن يُرِيدُ أَن يَرْجِعَ إِلَى رَبِّهِ أَمَلاً مُقِلاً * ثُمَّ أَتْلَى فُتًى ذِكْرَ مَآلِهِ يَجْمَعُكُمْ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْجَمْعِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ وَمَن يُؤْمِن بِاللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا يُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فَيَشْمَأَزُ أَ ن يَدْخُلَ الْفُتًى ذِكْرَ مَآلِهِ مِن فُرَاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ أَوْ جَنَّاتِ الْفِردَوْسِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَخْفَى عَلَيْهِ مَوْعِدُ أَحَدٍ}

in_urdu.name: فرات
in_urdu.meaning: فرات کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت و فراوان پانی یا ندی
in_urdu.long_meaning: فرات ایک مذکر عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت و فراوان پانی یا ندی۔ فرات نامی شخص کی شخصیت کے بارے میں کہا جاتا ہے کہ وہ شخص خوش قسمت، نیک دل، اور گوارا ہے۔ اسلامی روایات کے مطابق فرات کا ذکر قرآن مجید میں آیا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फ़ुरात
in_hindi.meaning: फ़ुरात का अर्थ है सुंदर और अधिक पानी या नदी
in_hindi.long_meaning: फ़ुरात एक मस्कुलिन अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है सुंदर और अधिक पानी या नदी। फ़ुरात नाम के व्यक्ति के व्यक्तित्व के बारे में कहा जाता है कि वह व्यक्ति भाग्यशाली, नेक दिल और सौम्य होता है। इस्लामी परंपराओं के अनुसार फ़ुरात का उल्लेख कुरआन में आया है।

in_pashto.name: فرات
in_pashto.meaning: فرات د ښکلي او ډیر اوبو یا سيند مطلب دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: فرات یو مذکر عربي نوم دی چې معنی یې ښکلي او ډیر اوبو یا سيند دی. د فرات نوم لرونکي شخص په اړه ویل کیږي چې هغه خوشحاله، نیک دل او نرم دی. د اسلامي رواياتو له مخې د فرات يادونه په قرآن کريم کې شوې ده.

in_english.name: Furaat
in_english.meaning: beautiful and abundant water or river
in_english.long_meaning: Furaat is a masculine Arabic name that means beautiful and abundant water or river. The name Furaat is derived from the Arabic root 'ف-ر-ت' which is also related to the concept of abundance and beauty. In Islamic tradition, Furaat is mentioned in the Quran as a symbol of paradise and bliss. The name Furaat is associated with positive personality traits such as being lucky, kind-hearted, and gentle.

pronunciation.pashto: د فرات تلفظ د فو-رات دی

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, the name Furaat is often associated with the Biblical story of the Prophet Yunus (Jonah) who was swallowed by a whale and subsequently thrown out onto the shore of the city of Furaat (Tarshish) where he repented and was forgiven by Allah. The name thus represents a sense of spiritual journey and redemption.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Furaat reminds us of the ongoing process of personal transformation and renewal. Like the stream of water that flows continuously, we too must continuously flow in our spiritual growth, seeking forgiveness and guidance from Allah. The name also symbolizes the connection between the physical and spiritual worlds, and the importance of starting anew after experiencing trials and challenges. may Allah grant us the strength and determination to seek His forgiveness and guidance in all aspects of our lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Furaat symbolizes the overwhelming and uncontrollable floods of divine grace and mercy that shower upon the believers, purifying their souls and transforming their lives. It is also a reminder of the profound sense of relief and release that comes with submitting to Allah's will.

trends: Gaining popularity in Western Muslim communities
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Furaat remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
